Tired of watching AI tutorials and still not building anything? 👀

Meet AI Builder's Camp (ABC), a program under AI Empowered Club.

In 8 weeks, you'll:
✅ Discover your purpose
✅ Build your own digital product
✅ Learn how to sell it

…with Coach Jazmine, Coach Lloyd, your AI Council Leaders and a community that won't let you quit.

You are the hero. AI is the tool. 💜

Curious if ABC fits you? Send us a message.

AI-empowered, not powered by AI. 💜

Meet AI Empowered Club (AEC): a community where you learn AI with friends, not alone.

Inside AEC:
📅 AI Pulse and live events
✍️ Prompt Challenges
🏆 Share Wins
💬 Ask Jazmine
🎬 Webinar and masterclass replays

Plus self-paced courses on AI tools, content creation and growing your skills, and our 8-week program, AI Builder's Camp.

Want to join? Send us a message.

Thinking about joining AI Builder's Camp? Here are the questions we get most 👇

🧩 Do I need to be techy? You'll set up Claude and ChatGPT with step-by-step guides, and your coaches guide you every week.
🗓️ How much time does it take? A Saturday main session, a Tuesday hands-on lab, small-group coaching, a Thursday podcast and one weekly task.
▶️ What if I miss a session? Replays are posted in the community.
🎁 What will I have after 8 weeks? Your personal purpose blueprint, your own digital product, and the know-how to sell it.
💳 How much is it? Full details and pricing for Batch 3 are at aibuilderscamp.ph.

Batch 3 is coming. 👉 aibuilderscamp.ph

Still have a question? Drop it in the comments or send us a message.

What happens when you get stuck inside AI Builder's Camp? 🤔

You're never on your own. Here's how we help builders keep moving, week after week:

📅 A Saturday main session to learn the big idea
🛠️ A Tuesday hands-on lab to build it with guidance
🤝 Small-group coaching to get unstuck with your coach
▶️ Replays and a community for when life gets busy
✅ One weekly task, so progress adds up

By week 8: your purpose blueprint, your own digital product, and a plan to sell it.

Have a question about ABC? Drop it in the comments or send us a message. Batch 3 is coming. 👉 aibuilderscamp.ph
